cardOverview.overviewText: A versatile business card that provides value on travel, dining, and corporate spends, with milestone benefits and flexible redemption for entrepreneurs.

benefitRows.name: Dining
benefitRows.offer: Up to 20% discount on partner restaurants via Dineout when using your HDFC Bank Credit Card.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the Swiggy or Dineout app or website with your registered account. Explore the dining and order-in offers, choose your preferred meals or restaurants, and apply the offer during checkout. Pay using your HDFC Biz Power credit card to enjoy exclusive savings on your dining bills.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Fire and burglary insurance for shops up to ₹5 lakh.|Cash in safe/transit cover up to ₹25,000.|Electronic equipment insurance (excluding terrorism) up to ₹50,000.|Hospital cash (accident-only) payable per day up to ₹1,000.|Hospital cash (illness-only) payable per day up to ₹1,000.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Avail Insurance package starting at an annual premium of Rs.3,785 which includes the above.
